source_text: In contrast, female genital cutting (FGC), classified by the World Health Organization into four types ranging from partial or total removal of the clitoris (Type I) to infibulation involving narrowing of the vaginal opening (Type III), entails more extensive alteration or injury to external female genitalia, often with no medical justification.
